title: TRUNK-6688: Fix circular initialization error in logging setup
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->

This fixes an issue where, during initialization of the `ServiceContext` if a logger is configured, it would attempt to read a global property (for the log settings) which, if the `ServiceContext` was not fully configured before this happened, leads to a runtime NPE. This only triggers on Java 25, but it's a latent issue on earlier JVM versions.
